 5288| static int
 5289| md_is_closing_code_fence(MD_CTX* ctx, CHAR ch, OFF beg, OFF* p_end)
 5290| {
 5291|     OFF off = beg;
 5292|     int ret = FALSE;
 5293| 
 5294|     /* Closing fence must have at least the same length and use same char as
 5295|      * opening one. */
 5296|     while(off < ctx->size  &&  CH(off) == ch)
 5297|         off++;
 5298|     if(off - beg < ctx->code_fence_length)
 5299|         goto out;
 5300| 
 5301|     /* Optionally, space(s) can follow */
 5302|     while(off < ctx->size  &&  CH(off) == _T(' '))
 5303|         off++;
 5304| 
 5305|     /* But nothing more is allowed on the line. */
 5306|     if(off < ctx->size  &&  !ISNEWLINE(off))
 5307|         goto out;
 5308| 
 5309|     ret = TRUE;
 5310| 
 5311| out:
 5312|     /* Note we set *p_end even on failure: If we are not closing fence, caller
 5313|      * would eat the line anyway without any parsing. */
 5314|     *p_end = off;
 5315|     return ret;
 5316| }

 5318| /* Returns type of the raw HTML block, or FALSE if it is not HTML block.
 5319|  * (Refer to CommonMark specification for details about the types.)
 5320|  */
 5321| static int
 5322| md_is_html_block_start_condition(MD_CTX* ctx, OFF beg)
 5323| {
 5324|     typedef struct TAG_tag TAG;
 5325|     struct TAG_tag {
 5326|         const CHAR* name;
 5327|         unsigned len    : 8;
 5328|     };
 5329| 
 5330|     /* Type 6 is started by a long list of allowed tags. We use two-level
 5331|      * tree to speed-up the search. */
 5332| #ifdef X
 5333|     #undef X
 5334| #endif
 5335| #define X(name)     { _T(name), (sizeof(name)-1) / sizeof(CHAR) }
 5336| #define Xend        { NULL, 0 }
 5337|     static const TAG t1[] = { X("pre"), X("script"), X("style"), X("textarea"), Xend };
 5338| 
 5339|     static const TAG a6[] = { X("address"), X("article"), X("aside"), Xend };
 5340|     static const TAG b6[] = { X("base"), X("basefont"), X("blockquote"), X("body"), Xend };
 5341|     static const TAG c6[] = { X("caption"), X("center"), X("col"), X("colgroup"), Xend };
 5342|     static const TAG d6[] = { X("dd"), X("details"), X("dialog"), X("dir"),
 5343|                               X("div"), X("dl"), X("dt"), Xend };
 5344|     static const TAG f6[] = { X("fieldset"), X("figcaption"), X("figure"), X("footer"),
 5345|                               X("form"), X("frame"), X("frameset"), Xend };
 5346|     static const TAG h6[] = { X("h1"), X("head"), X("header"), X("hr"), X("html"), Xend };
 5347|     static const TAG i6[] = { X("iframe"), Xend };
 5348|     static const TAG l6[] = { X("legend"), X("li"), X("link"), Xend };
 5349|     static const TAG m6[] = { X("main"), X("menu"), X("menuitem"), Xend };
 5350|     static const TAG n6[] = { X("nav"), X("noframes"), Xend };
 5351|     static const TAG o6[] = { X("ol"), X("optgroup"), X("option"), Xend };
 5352|     static const TAG p6[] = { X("p"), X("param"), Xend };
 5353|     static const TAG s6[] = { X("section"), X("source"), X("summary"), Xend };
 5354|     static const TAG t6[] = { X("table"), X("tbody"), X("td"), X("tfoot"), X("th"),
 5355|                               X("thead"), X("title"), X("tr"), X("track"), Xend };
 5356|     static const TAG u6[] = { X("ul"), Xend };
 5357|     static const TAG xx[] = { Xend };
 5358| #undef X
 5359| 
 5360|     static const TAG* map6[26] = {
 5361|         a6, b6, c6, d6, xx, f6, xx, h6, i6, xx, xx, l6, m6,
 5362|         n6, o6, p6, xx, xx, s6, t6, u6, xx, xx, xx, xx, xx
 5363|     };
 5364|     OFF off = beg + 1;
 5365|     int i;
 5366| 
 5367|     /* Check for type 1: <script, <pre, or <style */
 5368|     for(i = 0; t1[i].name != NULL; i++) {
 5369|         if(off + t1[i].len <= ctx->size) {
 5370|             if(md_ascii_case_eq(STR(off), t1[i].name, t1[i].len))
 5371|                 return 1;
 5372|         }
 5373|     }
 5374| 
 5375|     /* Check for type 2: <!-- */
 5376|     if(off + 3 < ctx->size  &&  CH(off) == _T('!')  &&  CH(off+1) == _T('-')  &&  CH(off+2) == _T('-'))
 5377|         return 2;
 5378| 
 5379|     /* Check for type 3: <? */
 5380|     if(off < ctx->size  &&  CH(off) == _T('?'))
 5381|         return 3;
 5382| 
 5383|     /* Check for type 4 or 5: <! */
 5384|     if(off < ctx->size  &&  CH(off) == _T('!')) {
 5385|         /* Check for type 4: <! followed by uppercase letter. */
 5386|         if(off + 1 < ctx->size  &&  ISASCII(off+1))
 5387|             return 4;
 5388| 
 5389|         /* Check for type 5: <![CDATA[ */
 5390|         if(off + 8 < ctx->size) {
 5391|             if(md_ascii_eq(STR(off), _T("![CDATA["), 8))
 5392|                 return 5;
 5393|         }
 5394|     }
 5395| 
 5396|     /* Check for type 6: Many possible starting tags listed above. */
 5397|     if(off + 1 < ctx->size  &&  (ISALPHA(off) || (CH(off) == _T('/') && ISALPHA(off+1)))) {
 5398|         int slot;
 5399|         const TAG* tags;
 5400| 
 5401|         if(CH(off) == _T('/'))
 5402|             off++;
 5403| 
 5404|         slot = (ISUPPER(off) ? CH(off) - 'A' : CH(off) - 'a');
 5405|         tags = map6[slot];
 5406| 
 5407|         for(i = 0; tags[i].name != NULL; i++) {
 5408|             if(off + tags[i].len <= ctx->size) {
 5409|                 if(md_ascii_case_eq(STR(off), tags[i].name, tags[i].len)) {
 5410|                     OFF tmp = off + tags[i].len;
 5411|                     if(tmp >= ctx->size)
 5412|                         return 6;
 5413|                     if(ISBLANK(tmp) || ISNEWLINE(tmp) || CH(tmp) == _T('>'))
 5414|                         return 6;
 5415|                     if(tmp+1 < ctx->size && CH(tmp) == _T('/') && CH(tmp+1) == _T('>'))
 5416|                         return 6;
 5417|                     break;
 5418|                 }
 5419|             }
 5420|         }
 5421|     }
 5422| 
 5423|     /* Check for type 7: any COMPLETE other opening or closing tag. */
 5424|     if(off + 1 < ctx->size) {
 5425|         OFF end;
 5426| 
 5427|         if(md_is_html_tag(ctx, NULL, 0, beg, ctx->size, &end)) {
 5428|             /* Only optional whitespace and new line may follow. */
 5429|             while(end < ctx->size  &&  ISWHITESPACE(end))
 5430|                 end++;
 5431|             if(end >= ctx->size  ||  ISNEWLINE(end))
 5432|                 return 7;
 5433|         }
 5434|     }
 5435| 
 5436|     return FALSE;
 5437| }

 5439| /* Case sensitive check whether there is a substring 'what' between 'beg'
 5440|  * and end of line. */
 5441| static int
 5442| md_line_contains(MD_CTX* ctx, OFF beg, const CHAR* what, SZ what_len, OFF* p_end)
 5443| {
 5444|     OFF i;
 5445|     for(i = beg; i + what_len < ctx->size; i++) {
 5446|         if(ISNEWLINE(i))
 5447|             break;
 5448|         if(memcmp(STR(i), what, what_len * sizeof(CHAR)) == 0) {
 5449|             *p_end = i + what_len;
 5450|             return TRUE;
 5451|         }
 5452|     }
 5453| 
 5454|     *p_end = i;
 5455|     return FALSE;
 5456| }

 5458| /* Returns type of HTML block end condition or FALSE if not an end condition.
 5459|  *
 5460|  * Note it fills p_end even when it is not end condition as the caller
 5461|  * does not need to analyze contents of a raw HTML block.
 5462|  */
 5463| static int
 5464| md_is_html_block_end_condition(MD_CTX* ctx, OFF beg, OFF* p_end)
 5465| {
 5466|     switch(ctx->html_block_type) {
 5467|         case 1:
 5468|         {
 5469|             OFF off = beg;
 5470| 
 5471|             while(off < ctx->size  &&  !ISNEWLINE(off)) {
 5472|                 if(CH(off) == _T('<')) {
 5473|                     if(md_ascii_case_eq(STR(off), _T("</script>"), 9)) {
 5474|                         *p_end = off + 9;
 5475|                         return TRUE;
 5476|                     }
 5477| 
 5478|                     if(md_ascii_case_eq(STR(off), _T("</style>"), 8)) {
 5479|                         *p_end = off + 8;
 5480|                         return TRUE;
 5481|                     }
 5482| 
 5483|                     if(md_ascii_case_eq(STR(off), _T("</pre>"), 6)) {
 5484|                         *p_end = off + 6;
 5485|                         return TRUE;
 5486|                     }
 5487|                 }
 5488| 
 5489|                 off++;
 5490|             }
 5491|             *p_end = off;
 5492|             return FALSE;
 5493|         }
 5494| 
 5495|         case 2:
 5496|             return (md_line_contains(ctx, beg, _T("-->"), 3, p_end) ? 2 : FALSE);
 5497| 
 5498|         case 3:
 5499|             return (md_line_contains(ctx, beg, _T("?>"), 2, p_end) ? 3 : FALSE);
 5500| 
 5501|         case 4:
 5502|             return (md_line_contains(ctx, beg, _T(">"), 1, p_end) ? 4 : FALSE);
 5503| 
 5504|         case 5:
 5505|             return (md_line_contains(ctx, beg, _T("]]>"), 3, p_end) ? 5 : FALSE);
 5506| 
 5507|         case 6:     /* Pass through */
 5508|         case 7:
 5509|             *p_end = beg;
 5510|             return (ISNEWLINE(beg) ? ctx->html_block_type : FALSE);
 5511| 
 5512|         default:
 5513|             MD_UNREACHABLE();
 5514|     }
 5515|     return FALSE;
 5516| }

 5647| md_is_container_mark(MD_CTX* ctx, unsigned indent, OFF beg, OFF* p_end, MD_CONTAINER* p_container)
 5648| {

 5653|         return FALSE;

 5660|         p_container->is_task = FALSE;

 5662|         p_container->contents_indent = indent + 1;

 5667|     /* Check for list item bullet mark. */
 5668|     if(ISANYOF(off, _T("-+*"))  &&  (off+1 >= ctx->size || ISBLANK(off+1) || ISNEWLINE(off+1))) {
 5669|         p_container->ch = CH(off);
 5670|         p_container->is_loose = FALSE;
 5671|         p_container->is_task = FALSE;
 5672|         p_container->mark_indent = indent;
 5673|         p_container->contents_indent = indent + 1;
 5674|         *p_end = off+1;
 5675|         return TRUE;
 5676|     }
 5677| 
 5678|     /* Check for ordered list item marks. */
 5679|     max_end = off + 9;
 5680|     if(max_end > ctx->size)
 5681|         max_end = ctx->size;
 5682|     p_container->start = 0;
 5683|     while(off < max_end  &&  ISDIGIT(off)) {
 5684|         p_container->start = p_container->start * 10 + CH(off) - _T('0');
 5685|         off++;
 5686|     }
 5687|     if(off > beg  &&
 5688|        (CH(off) == _T('.') || CH(off) == _T(')'))  &&
 5689|        (off+1 >= ctx->size || ISBLANK(off+1) || ISNEWLINE(off+1)))
 5690|     {
 5691|         p_container->ch = CH(off);
 5692|         p_container->is_loose = FALSE;
 5693|         p_container->is_task = FALSE;
 5694|         p_container->mark_indent = indent;
 5695|         p_container->contents_indent = indent + off - beg + 1;
 5696|         *p_end = off+1;

 5698|     }

 5700|     return FALSE;

 5712|         else

 5722| 
 5723| /* Analyze type of the line and find some its properties. This serves as a
 5724|  * main input for determining type and boundaries of a block. */
 5725| static int
 5726| md_analyze_line(MD_CTX* ctx, OFF beg, OFF* p_end,
 5727|                 const MD_LINE_ANALYSIS* pivot_line, MD_LINE_ANALYSIS* line)
 5728| {
 5729|     unsigned total_indent = 0;
 5730|     int n_parents = 0;
 5731|     int n_brothers = 0;
 5732|     int n_children = 0;
 5733|     MD_CONTAINER container = { 0 };
 5734|     int prev_line_has_list_loosening_effect = ctx->last_line_has_list_loosening_effect;
 5735|     OFF off = beg;
 5736|     OFF hr_killer = 0;
 5737|     int ret = 0;
 5738| 
 5739|     line->indent = md_line_indentation(ctx, total_indent, off, &off);
 5740|     total_indent += line->indent;
 5741|     line->beg = off;
 5742| 
 5743|     /* Given the indentation and block quote marks '>', determine how many of
 5744|      * the current containers are our parents. */
 5745|     while(n_parents < ctx->n_containers) {
 5746|         MD_CONTAINER* c = &ctx->containers[n_parents];
 5747| 
 5748|         if(c->ch == _T('>')  &&  line->indent < ctx->code_indent_offset  &&
 5749|             off < ctx->size  &&  CH(off) == _T('>'))
 5750|         {
 5751|             /* Block quote mark. */
 5752|             off++;
 5753|             total_indent++;
 5754|             line->indent = md_line_indentation(ctx, total_indent, off, &off);
 5755|             total_indent += line->indent;
 5756| 
 5757|             /* The optional 1st space after '>' is part of the block quote mark. */
 5758|             if(line->indent > 0)
 5759|                 line->indent--;
 5760| 
 5761|             line->beg = off;
 5762| 
 5763|         } else if(c->ch != _T('>')  &&  line->indent >= c->contents_indent) {
 5764|             /* List. */
 5765|             line->indent -= c->contents_indent;
 5766|         } else {
 5767|             break;
 5768|         }
 5769| 
 5770|         n_parents++;
 5771|     }
 5772| 
 5773|     if(off >= ctx->size  ||  ISNEWLINE(off)) {
 5774|         /* Blank line does not need any real indentation to be nested inside
 5775|          * a list. */
 5776|         if(n_brothers + n_children == 0) {
 5777|             while(n_parents < ctx->n_containers  &&  ctx->containers[n_parents].ch != _T('>'))
 5778|                 n_parents++;
 5779|         }
 5780|     }
 5781| 
 5782|     while(TRUE) {
 5783|         /* Check whether we are fenced code continuation. */
 5784|         if(pivot_line->type == MD_LINE_FENCEDCODE) {
 5785|             line->beg = off;
 5786| 
 5787|             /* We are another MD_LINE_FENCEDCODE unless we are closing fence
 5788|              * which we transform into MD_LINE_BLANK. */
 5789|             if(line->indent < ctx->code_indent_offset) {
 5790|                 if(md_is_closing_code_fence(ctx, CH(pivot_line->beg), off, &off)) {

 5792|                     ctx->last_line_has_list_loosening_effect = FALSE;

 6206| static int
 6207| md_process_line(MD_CTX* ctx, const MD_LINE_ANALYSIS** p_pivot_line, MD_LINE_ANALYSIS* line)
 6208| {
 6209|     const MD_LINE_ANALYSIS* pivot_line = *p_pivot_line;
 6210|     int ret = 0;
 6211| 
 6212|     /* Blank line ends current leaf block. */
 6213|     if(line->type == MD_LINE_BLANK) {
 6214|         MD_CHECK(md_end_current_block(ctx));
 6215|         *p_pivot_line = &md_dummy_blank_line;
 6216|         return 0;
 6217|     }
 6218| 
 6219|     /* Some line types form block on their own. */
 6220|     if(line->type == MD_LINE_HR || line->type == MD_LINE_ATXHEADER) {
 6221|         MD_CHECK(md_end_current_block(ctx));
 6222| 
 6223|         /* Add our single-line block. */
 6224|         MD_CHECK(md_start_new_block(ctx, line));
 6225|         MD_CHECK(md_add_line_into_current_block(ctx, line));
 6226|         MD_CHECK(md_end_current_block(ctx));
 6227|         *p_pivot_line = &md_dummy_blank_line;
 6228|         return 0;
 6229|     }
 6230| 
 6231|     /* MD_LINE_SETEXTUNDERLINE changes meaning of the current block and ends it. */
 6232|     if(line->type == MD_LINE_SETEXTUNDERLINE) {
 6233|         MD_ASSERT(ctx->current_block != NULL);
 6234|         ctx->current_block->type = MD_BLOCK_H;
 6235|         ctx->current_block->data = line->data;
 6236|         ctx->current_block->flags |= MD_BLOCK_SETEXT_HEADER;
 6237|         MD_CHECK(md_add_line_into_current_block(ctx, line));
 6238|         MD_CHECK(md_end_current_block(ctx));
 6239|         if(ctx->current_block == NULL) {
 6240|             *p_pivot_line = &md_dummy_blank_line;
 6241|         } else {
 6242|             /* This happens if we have consumed all the body as link ref. defs.
 6243|              * and downgraded the underline into start of a new paragraph block. */
 6244|             line->type = MD_LINE_TEXT;
 6245|             *p_pivot_line = line;
 6246|         }
 6247|         return 0;
 6248|     }
 6249| 
 6250|     /* MD_LINE_TABLEUNDERLINE changes meaning of the current block. */
 6251|     if(line->type == MD_LINE_TABLEUNDERLINE) {
 6252|         MD_ASSERT(ctx->current_block != NULL);
 6253|         MD_ASSERT(ctx->current_block->n_lines == 1);
 6254|         ctx->current_block->type = MD_BLOCK_TABLE;
 6255|         ctx->current_block->data = line->data;
 6256|         MD_ASSERT(pivot_line != &md_dummy_blank_line);
 6257|         ((MD_LINE_ANALYSIS*)pivot_line)->type = MD_LINE_TABLE;
 6258|         MD_CHECK(md_add_line_into_current_block(ctx, line));
 6259|         return 0;
 6260|     }
 6261| 
 6262|     /* The current block also ends if the line has different type. */
 6263|     if(line->type != pivot_line->type)
 6264|         MD_CHECK(md_end_current_block(ctx));
 6265| 
 6266|     /* The current line may start a new block. */
 6267|     if(ctx->current_block == NULL) {
 6268|         MD_CHECK(md_start_new_block(ctx, line));
 6269|         *p_pivot_line = line;
 6270|     }
 6271| 
 6272|     /* In all other cases the line is just a continuation of the current block. */
 6273|     MD_CHECK(md_add_line_into_current_block(ctx, line));
 6274| 
 6275| abort:
 6276|     return ret;
 6277| }

 6340| int
 6341| md_parse(const MD_CHAR* text, MD_SIZE size, const MD_PARSER* parser, void* userdata)
 6342| {
 6343|     MD_CTX ctx;
 6344|     int i;
 6345|     int ret;
 6346| 
 6347|     if(parser->abi_version != 0) {
 6348|         if(parser->debug_log != NULL)
 6349|             parser->debug_log("Unsupported abi_version.", userdata);
 6350|         return -1;
 6351|     }
 6352| 
 6353|     /* Setup context structure. */
 6354|     memset(&ctx, 0, sizeof(MD_CTX));
 6355|     ctx.text = text;
 6356|     ctx.size = size;
 6357|     memcpy(&ctx.parser, parser, sizeof(MD_PARSER));
 6358|     ctx.userdata = userdata;
 6359|     ctx.code_indent_offset = (ctx.parser.flags & MD_FLAG_NOINDENTEDCODEBLOCKS) ? (OFF)(-1) : 4;
 6360|     md_build_mark_char_map(&ctx);
 6361|     ctx.doc_ends_with_newline = (size > 0  &&  ISNEWLINE_(text[size-1]));
 6362| 
 6363|     /* Reset all unresolved opener mark chains. */
 6364|     for(i = 0; i < (int) SIZEOF_ARRAY(ctx.mark_chains); i++) {
 6365|         ctx.mark_chains[i].head = -1;
 6366|         ctx.mark_chains[i].tail = -1;
 6367|     }
 6368|     ctx.unresolved_link_head = -1;
 6369|     ctx.unresolved_link_tail = -1;
 6370| 
 6371|     /* All the work. */
 6372|     ret = md_process_doc(&ctx);
 6373| 
 6374|     /* Clean-up. */
 6375|     md_free_ref_defs(&ctx);
 6376|     md_free_ref_def_hashtable(&ctx);
 6377|     free(ctx.buffer);
 6378|     free(ctx.marks);
 6379|     free(ctx.block_bytes);

   85| static void
   86| render_html_escaped(MD_HTML* r, const MD_CHAR* data, MD_SIZE size)
   87| {
   88|     MD_OFFSET beg = 0;
   89|     MD_OFFSET off = 0;
   90| 
   91|     /* Some characters need to be escaped in normal HTML text. */
   92|     #define NEED_HTML_ESC(ch)   (r->escape_map[(unsigned char)(ch)] & NEED_HTML_ESC_FLAG)
   93| 
   94|     while(1) {
   95|         /* Optimization: Use some loop unrolling. */
   96|         while(off + 3 < size  &&  !NEED_HTML_ESC(data[off+0])  &&  !NEED_HTML_ESC(data[off+1])
   97|                               &&  !NEED_HTML_ESC(data[off+2])  &&  !NEED_HTML_ESC(data[off+3]))
   98|             off += 4;
   99|         while(off < size  &&  !NEED_HTML_ESC(data[off]))
  100|             off++;
  101| 
  102|         if(off > beg)
  103|             render_verbatim(r, data + beg, off - beg);
  104| 
  105|         if(off < size) {
  106|             switch(data[off]) {
  107|                 case '&':   RENDER_VERBATIM(r, "&"); break;
  108|                 case '<':   RENDER_VERBATIM(r, "<"); break;
  109|                 case '>':   RENDER_VERBATIM(r, ">"); break;
  110|                 case '"':   RENDER_VERBATIM(r, """); break;
  111|             }
  112|             off++;
  113|         } else {
  114|             break;
  115|         }
  116|         beg = off;
  117|     }
  118| }

  120| static void
  121| render_url_escaped(MD_HTML* r, const MD_CHAR* data, MD_SIZE size)
  122| {
  123|     static const MD_CHAR hex_chars[] = "0123456789ABCDEF";
  124|     MD_OFFSET beg = 0;
  125|     MD_OFFSET off = 0;
  126| 
  127|     /* Some characters need to be escaped in URL attributes. */
  128|     #define NEED_URL_ESC(ch)    (r->escape_map[(unsigned char)(ch)] & NEED_URL_ESC_FLAG)
  129| 
  130|     while(1) {
  131|         while(off < size  &&  !NEED_URL_ESC(data[off]))
  132|             off++;
  133|         if(off > beg)
  134|             render_verbatim(r, data + beg, off - beg);
  135| 
  136|         if(off < size) {
  137|             char hex[3];
  138| 
  139|             switch(data[off]) {
  140|                 case '&':   RENDER_VERBATIM(r, "&"); break;
  141|                 default:
  142|                     hex[0] = '%';
  143|                     hex[1] = hex_chars[((unsigned)data[off] >> 4) & 0xf];
  144|                     hex[2] = hex_chars[((unsigned)data[off] >> 0) & 0xf];
  145|                     render_verbatim(r, hex, 3);
  146|                     break;
  147|             }
  148|             off++;
  149|         } else {
  150|             break;
  151|         }
  152| 
  153|         beg = off;
  154|     }
  155| }

  157| static unsigned
  158| hex_val(char ch)
  159| {
  160|     if('0' <= ch && ch <= '9')
  161|         return ch - '0';
  162|     if('A' <= ch && ch <= 'Z')
  163|         return ch - 'A' + 10;
  164|     else
  165|         return ch - 'a' + 10;
  166| }

  168| static void
  169| render_utf8_codepoint(MD_HTML* r, unsigned codepoint,
  170|                       void (*fn_append)(MD_HTML*, const MD_CHAR*, MD_SIZE))
  171| {
  172|     static const MD_CHAR utf8_replacement_char[] = { 0xef, 0xbf, 0xbd };
  173| 
  174|     unsigned char utf8[4];
  175|     size_t n;
  176| 
  177|     if(codepoint <= 0x7f) {
  178|         n = 1;
  179|         utf8[0] = codepoint;
  180|     } else if(codepoint <= 0x7ff) {
  181|         n = 2;
  182|         utf8[0] = 0xc0 | ((codepoint >>  6) & 0x1f);
  183|         utf8[1] = 0x80 + ((codepoint >>  0) & 0x3f);
  184|     } else if(codepoint <= 0xffff) {
  185|         n = 3;
  186|         utf8[0] = 0xe0 | ((codepoint >> 12) & 0xf);
  187|         utf8[1] = 0x80 + ((codepoint >>  6) & 0x3f);
  188|         utf8[2] = 0x80 + ((codepoint >>  0) & 0x3f);
  189|     } else {
  190|         n = 4;
  191|         utf8[0] = 0xf0 | ((codepoint >> 18) & 0x7);
  192|         utf8[1] = 0x80 + ((codepoint >> 12) & 0x3f);
  193|         utf8[2] = 0x80 + ((codepoint >>  6) & 0x3f);
  194|         utf8[3] = 0x80 + ((codepoint >>  0) & 0x3f);
  195|     }
  196| 
  197|     if(0 < codepoint  &&  codepoint <= 0x10ffff)
  198|         fn_append(r, (char*)utf8, (MD_SIZE)n);
  199|     else
  200|         fn_append(r, utf8_replacement_char, 3);
  201| }

  203| /* Translate entity to its UTF-8 equivalent, or output the verbatim one
  204|  * if such entity is unknown (or if the translation is disabled). */
  205| static void
  206| render_entity(MD_HTML* r, const MD_CHAR* text, MD_SIZE size,
  207|               void (*fn_append)(MD_HTML*, const MD_CHAR*, MD_SIZE))
  208| {
  209|     if(r->flags & MD_HTML_FLAG_VERBATIM_ENTITIES) {
  210|         render_verbatim(r, text, size);
  211|         return;
  212|     }
  213| 
  214|     /* We assume UTF-8 output is what is desired. */
  215|     if(size > 3 && text[1] == '#') {
  216|         unsigned codepoint = 0;
  217| 
  218|         if(text[2] == 'x' || text[2] == 'X') {
  219|             /* Hexadecimal entity (e.g. "&#x1234abcd;")). */
  220|             MD_SIZE i;
  221|             for(i = 3; i < size-1; i++)
  222|                 codepoint = 16 * codepoint + hex_val(text[i]);
  223|         } else {
  224|             /* Decimal entity (e.g. "&1234;") */
  225|             MD_SIZE i;
  226|             for(i = 2; i < size-1; i++)
  227|                 codepoint = 10 * codepoint + (text[i] - '0');
  228|         }
  229| 
  230|         render_utf8_codepoint(r, codepoint, fn_append);
  231|         return;
  232|     } else {
  233|         /* Named entity (e.g. " "). */
  234|         const struct entity* ent;
  235| 
  236|         ent = entity_lookup(text, size);
  237|         if(ent != NULL) {
  238|             render_utf8_codepoint(r, ent->codepoints[0], fn_append);
  239|             if(ent->codepoints[1])
  240|                 render_utf8_codepoint(r, ent->codepoints[1], fn_append);
  241|             return;
  242|         }
  243|     }
  244| 
  245|     fn_append(r, text, size);
  246| }

  248| static void
  249| render_attribute(MD_HTML* r, const MD_ATTRIBUTE* attr,
  250|                  void (*fn_append)(MD_HTML*, const MD_CHAR*, MD_SIZE))
  251| {
  252|     int i;
  253| 
  254|     for(i = 0; attr->substr_offsets[i] < attr->size; i++) {
  255|         MD_TEXTTYPE type = attr->substr_types[i];
  256|         MD_OFFSET off = attr->substr_offsets[i];
  257|         MD_SIZE size = attr->substr_offsets[i+1] - off;
  258|         const MD_CHAR* text = attr->text + off;
  259| 
  260|         switch(type) {
  261|             case MD_TEXT_NULLCHAR:  render_utf8_codepoint(r, 0x0000, render_verbatim); break;
  262|             case MD_TEXT_ENTITY:    render_entity(r, text, size, fn_append); break;
  263|             default:                fn_append(r, text, size); break;
  264|         }
  265|     }
  266| }

  391|         case MD_BLOCK_H:        RENDER_VERBATIM(r, head[((MD_BLOCK_H_DETAIL*)detail)->level - 1]); break;

  400|         case MD_BLOCK_TD:       render_open_td_block(r, "td", (MD_BLOCK_TD_DETAIL*)detail); break;
  401|     }
  402| 
  403|     return 0;

  434| static int
  435| enter_span_callback(MD_SPANTYPE type, void* detail, void* userdata)
  436| {
  437|     MD_HTML* r = (MD_HTML*) userdata;
  438| 
  439|     if(r->image_nesting_level > 0) {
  440|         /* We are inside a Markdown image label. Markdown allows to use any
  441|          * emphasis and other rich contents in that context similarly as in
  442|          * any link label.
  443|          *
  444|          * However, unlike in the case of links (where that contents becomes
  445|          * contents of the <a>...</a> tag), in the case of images the contents
  446|          * is supposed to fall into the attribute alt: <img alt="...">.
  447|          *
  448|          * In that context we naturally cannot output nested HTML tags. So lets
  449|          * suppress them and only output the plain text (i.e. what falls into
  450|          * text() callback).
  451|          *
  452|          * This make-it-a-plain-text approach is the recommended practice by
  453|          * CommonMark specification (for HTML output).
  454|          */
  455|         return 0;

  531| int
  532| md_html(const MD_CHAR* input, MD_SIZE input_size,
  533|         void (*process_output)(const MD_CHAR*, MD_SIZE, void*),
  534|         void* userdata, unsigned parser_flags, unsigned renderer_flags)
  535| {
  536|     MD_HTML render = { process_output, userdata, renderer_flags, 0, { 0 } };
  537|     int i;
  538| 
  539|     MD_PARSER parser = {
  540|         0,
  541|         parser_flags,
  542|         enter_block_callback,
  543|         leave_block_callback,
  544|         enter_span_callback,
  545|         leave_span_callback,
  546|         text_callback,
  547|         debug_log_callback,
  548|         NULL
  549|     };
  550| 
  551|     /* Build map of characters which need escaping. */
  552|     for(i = 0; i < 256; i++) {
  553|         unsigned char ch = (unsigned char) i;
  554| 
  555|         if(strchr("\"&<>", ch) != NULL)
  556|             render.escape_map[i] |= NEED_HTML_ESC_FLAG;
  557| 
  558|         if(!ISALNUM(ch)  &&  strchr("~-_.+!*(),%#@?=;:/,+$", ch) == NULL)
  559|             render.escape_map[i] |= NEED_URL_ESC_FLAG;
  560|     }
  561| 
  562|     /* Consider skipping UTF-8 byte order mark (BOM). */
  563|     if(renderer_flags & MD_HTML_FLAG_SKIP_UTF8_BOM  &&  sizeof(MD_CHAR) == 1) {
  564|         static const MD_CHAR bom[3] = { 0xef, 0xbb, 0xbf };
  565|         if(input_size >= sizeof(bom)  &&  memcmp(input, bom, sizeof(bom)) == 0) {
  566|             input += sizeof(bom);
  567|             input_size -= sizeof(bom);
  568|         }
  569|     }
  570| 
  571|     return md_parse(input, input_size, &parser, (void*) &render);
  572| }
